summary: Iter 44 — Super-Admin dashboard cleanup + course-content completeness verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest scenarios pass — (a) /api/admin/alerts returns real signals only (no 'stub-' ids, no license-expiry/storage-threshold, no stubbed:true flag); currently returns 1 real alert ('orphan-enrollments'); (b) /api/admin/dashboard kpis.revenue_total present, mock_revenue_total absent; (c) /api/courses returns exactly 28 courses; (d) agentic-ai-healthcare, agentic-ai-retail, multi-agent-systems — every lesson.content >= 1200 chars. Frontend: superadmin login OK, /admin loads Overview with no 'Stub' or 'Mock revenue' text, kpi-revenue label is 'Revenue (paid)' with numeric value ($0 — correct given clean preview DB), kpi-total-users -> Users tab, kpi-active-7d -> Sessions tab, kpi-enrollments -> ts-metric='enrollments', kpi-revenue -> ts-metric='orders', deep links /admin?tab=audit and /admin?tab=videoquiz correctly select their tabs on load, all 5 Overview charts (signups-enrollments line, top-courses bar, band pie, language pie, geo card) render without console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_control_router.py get_alerts docstring still says 'stubbed categories are marked with `stubbed: true`' (line 249) which is now stale — the stub categories were fully removed, no code path emits stubbed:true anymore. Minor cosmetic doc-string fix.

AlertsPanel.jsx uses `a.id` as the React key for each alert. All current alert ids are unique strings, but if a future alert type (e.g., traffic-dropoff repeated per day) is added to the /alerts feed with a duplicate id, React will warn. Consider `${a.id}-${idx}` defensively.

KpiDashboard.jsx: `Kpi` component sets role='button' on click but does not add tabIndex or a keyboard onKeyDown handler — the whole KPI card is not keyboard-accessible (Enter/Space won't trigger the navigate). Non-blocking for now, but worth adding for a11y.
